parts.name: Toilet Bowl and Base
parts.description: The toilet bowl and base are made of ceramic, forming the main structure of the toilet.

parts.name: Cistern (Water Tank)
parts.description: The cistern is a ceramic water tank attached to the back of the toilet.

parts.name: Toilet Seat and Lid
parts.description: The toilet seat and lid are made of plastic and attached to the bowl with hinges.
